about: Claims register for the App Store copy. Every figure in the five copy files points at the repository file that holds its evidence. Checked by scripts/check_claims.py, which also says what this does not cover. A claim is the exact fragment as the copy prints it. Evidence is a file in this repository and a string that must still be in it; a BenchmarkRuns folder is named without a string because BenchmarkRuns/* is gitignored. A memory note or a file outside the repository is never evidence. Status: verified (evidence found and confirmed), unverified (not found, with a note of where it was looked for), mismatch (the copy disagrees with its evidence).

not_claims.reason: The app's version number used as a name (5.7, 5.8), not a figure about what the app does. Add the next version here when the copy names it.
The name of a person's first library (ContainerService.firstLibraryName); the 1 is part of the name, not a quantity.
